title: Brand & Content Lead
description:
In Short: We are looking for someone that loves content and eCommerce to own our entire brand surface — content, community, product marketing, and website — and turn Klar into the go-to resource for actionable eCom knowledge in Europe.

About Klar

🚀 The Mission

Klar is the Data Operating System for growing eCommerce companies, meaning no more spreadsheets. We integrate with all of a brand's data sources to provide a holistic understanding of their business, offering detailed insights on how to accelerate growth and increase profitability.

🛍️ The Reach

We are already the "single source of truth" for over 1,000 leading eCom brands. Market leaders like Sunday Natural, Loop Earplugs, Holy, Maniko, and Armed Angels use Klar to make better decisions every single day.

🤝 The Backstory

We deeply empathize with our customers because we were our customers. The founders (who met in South Africa working for Zando) spent the last 10 years in e-commerce. We know the pain of running these businesses, and we built Klar specifically to solve it.

✨ The Principle

Our guiding principle is Do Work You Are Proud Of. We emphasize long-term quality over short-term results. We evaluate our tools and decisions wisely because we want to be proud of what we build together.

Tasks

About The Position

Klar has two big assets outside of our software: the content we produce and the eCom Unity, Germany's largest eCommerce community with 2,500+ active operators. Both are running today — but honestly, neither is running at the level it could. That's where you come in.

You will own our brand end-to-end and build it into a well-oiled machine. Concretely, that means four areas:

1. The Content Engine

We are in the early stages of building a scalable, consistent content operation, and you will play a major role in deciding what it becomes. You will own the overall direction, identify which formats and channels we should double down on, and turn them into a content engine that ships reliably and at a high bar.

Here is what we are currently thinking:

  • A weekly newsletter that shares the biggest knowledge bombs from our community, workshops, and own research — no fluff, operational insights only.
  • A podcast and/or YouTube channel where we go deep with the best operators in eCom on how they actually grow their businesses. Not “here is our founding story” — straight to the operational meat.
  • Personal branding on LinkedIn for our founders and team members. You will build the system, develop the angles, and yes — write in other people’s voices. If ghostwriting feels beneath you, this is not your role.

You will already have a Content & Video Producer on your team, who is also happy to jump in front of the camera and take ownership beyond production. Together, you will orchestrate the content process from idea to distribution. We work AI-first - a well-set-up Claude gets you 90% of a draft; your judgment, taste, and editing get it to 100%.

2. Community & Events

The eCom Unity runs 20+ IRL events per year like our pre-OMR meetup with 150 operators and a bunch of online workshops. Two people on the team run this today, and it's largely on autopilot — your job is to guide them, connect the community to the content engine (every event is content, every discussion is a newsletter), and push the eCom Unity into its next phase as a genuine media asset.

3. Product Marketing

How we talk about Klar — our positioning, our messaging, and our anti-hype stance in a market full of hype — is something you will own and shape. You will be the strategic counterpart to Max, our founder, who is deeply opinionated on this. Your role is to challenge his perspective, sharpen our thinking, and translate a complex product into clear, compelling messaging that makes its value immediately obvious.

4. Website & Sales Collateral

You own our website (Webflow) and the collateral our sales team needs. You should be able to execute most of this yourself — with Figma, Webflow, and AI tools like Claude Code — and pull in engineering or freelancers when needed.

What success looks like after 12 months: a content machine that ships consistently and at high quality, a growing audience (newsletter, community, social) that considers Klar one of the go-to resources for eCom knowledge in Europe — and a measurable content contribution to our pipeline.

Requirements

About You

  • You are among the best at what you do - we are looking for extraordinarily talented people who are looking to take their career and knowledge to the next level. You likely have 5–10 years of experience across content, brand, or product marketing.
  • You are smart & naturally curious - existing in-depth knowledge of eCommerce would be ideal, of course, but we understand that this might be a stretch. Thus, you need to be excited to dig into new industries and gain knowledge of the brands, people and operations in it.
  • You are a great writer and editor - most content starts as words. You write excellent copy in English (German is a plus), and you have the taste to take an AI-generated draft from good to great. You know the difference.
  • You are a builder, not just a strategist - you don't need a team of ten to ship. You're comfortable in Webflow, Figma, and AI tools, and you'd rather publish this week than perfect a strategy deck.
  • You lead through others - you'll guide our community team and work with our video editor. You don't need formal authority to get people moving.
  • You optimize for learning - your main motivation at this point of your career is to learn as much as possible and broaden your tool set. You want to work with people of the same mindset and learn from each other.

Location: Munich preferred, remote possible.

Benefits

Our Offer

💰 Top-of-Market Compensation

We want to hire the best people out there to help make Klar successful, and we ensure you are compensated accordingly.

🕊️ Freedom & Impact

You will work with founders who truly "get" eCom and are super interested in your ideas. We give you the freedom you need to be successful and the space to take ownership from day one.

🎢 The Full Experience

We offer all the fun, struggle, challenge, and ultimately the elation and satisfaction that comes from building a kick-ass system. We will push you out of your comfort zone and challenge you, guaranteeing a steep personal and professional learning curve.

🔮 Massive Exposure

You get a look "behind the curtain" of how the best eCom brands operate. You will gain detailed insights into the strategies that work, backed by data from hundreds of brands.

🌍 Work From Anywhere

We are building a remote-first company. While we have a base in Munich, you have the flexibility to work from anywhere (ideally within GMT+0 to GMT+4 to keep our collaboration smooth).

🏃 Hiring Process

We are growing like crazy, so we aim to move fast - but we never compromise on quality. A normal process looks like this, but we’re happy to adapt it to your needs and ours:

📑 Application Review -> 👋🏼 First Interview -> 🧩 The Challenge -> 🧠 Deep Dive -> 🤝 Meet the Co-Founders -> 🎉 The Offer.

👋 How To Apply

Simply apply using Join.

Please include a few words (or a video) on why you think you are a great fit — and even better, one piece of content you'd make for Klar in your first month.

title: Country Director Germany (Interim 1 year)
description:
Fastned is one of Europe's leading fast-charging networks. Active across 9 countries, we have spent nearly 15 years building the infrastructure, expertise and brand that defines premium fast charging in Europe. What sets us apart is our focus on reliability, sustainability and clean energy. We have been awarded “Best Charging Network” in the UK, France, Switzerland and the Netherlands, further establishing Fastned as a leading player in the field. This is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and drive change in an exciting industry of the future! Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution!

As our Interim Country Director, you will help accelerate the growth of the German market with our ambition to become a leading player in the EV transition. You will be instrumental in executing Fastned’s strategic vision, driving operational excellence, and nurturing a high-performing local team. This high-impact leadership role offers a unique opportunity to shape our commercial success and leave a lasting mark on the future of electric mobility.

This interim role is set to start as soon as possible and will finish at the end of December 2027. Our German office is located in Cologne, you are expected to be present on location at least 3 days per week. In this role you will report directly to our COO. 

What you will be doing

Drive German Deployment and Operational Excellence

  • Accelerate network deployment by proactively removing bottlenecks, ensuring rapid and strategic scaling across the market.

  • Partner with the Country Execution Lead to drive cross-functional collaboration, ensuring our pipeline consistently delivers high-potential locations on schedule.

  • Champion a world-class customer experience by collaborating with Local Operations to maintain pristine, high-uptime stations that exceed charging performance standards.

  • Oversee day-to-day operations with a focus on agility, continuously refining workflows to maintain momentum and operational excellence.

Elevate Commercial Performance

  • Collaborate with commercial teams to drive revenue, customer growth, brand visibility, and local marketing.

  • Identify opportunities, partnerships, and strategic initiatives to maximize market share and profitability.

  • Scale B2B and B2C offerings while optimizing pricing and business models.

  • Own the local P&L, balancing growth with cost efficiency to achieve financial targets.

Represent Fastned Germany internally and externally

  • Support the team in representing Fastned in the German EV ecosystem, incl. engaging with government bodies, stakeholders, and media to strengthen market position.

  • Represent the German market in central decision-making, providing feedback on plans and ensuring alignment with company policies.

  • Collaborate with legal teams to ensure regulatory compliance and risk mitigation.

Shape your country strategy & execution

  • Implement the German strategic plan, aligning with Fastned’s vision while adapting to local dynamics.

  • Incorporate market trends, competitive shifts, and policy changes into strategic planning.

  • Align the local team behind shared goals and continuously refine operational workflows.

  • Manage long-term business plans and annual tactical execution across local teams.

Display People & Culture Leadership  

  • Partner with HR to recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing, mission-driven team.

  • Lead local workforce planning, key role selection, onboarding, and leadership coaching.

  • Cultivate a culture of collaboration, innovation, and ownership aligned with Fastned’s values.

  • Facilitate seamless communication and alignment between local and global teams.

What you bring along

  • Proven experience in comparable senior management roles within a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Strong commercial background and expertise across B2B and B2C markets.

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and inspire teams.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills in both English and German.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

  • Passion for sustainability and the transition to electric mobility.  

What’s in it for you?

We value a healthy work-life balance, offer you genuine flexibility in your working arrangements and have established family-friendly policies. Our benefits include:

  • 29 holidays + 2 Mission Days you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you.

  • Flexible working hours, full travel expenses reimbursement and the IT equipment of your choice (e.g. MacBook or Dell XPS, iPhone or Android)

  • A “Deutschlandticket” covered by Fastned

  • Vegetarian lunch as well as snacks and drinks are provided at our office

title: Computational Physicist / Scientific Software Engineer – Deep Digital Twin Development (f/m/d)
description:
eleQtron develops full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Our approach combines laser-cooled ions, microwave and RF control, engineered magnetic field gradients, and advanced theoretical modelling to build scalable quantum processors. As our systems continue to grow in complexity and performance, predictive simulation tools are becoming a critical component for hardware development, calibration, optimisation, and fault-tolerant quantum computing. 

To strengthen our simulation and software efforts, we are looking for a Computational Physicist / Scientific Software Engineer who contributes to the Deep Digital Twin Development (f/m/d). 

Role Overview:

In this role, you will contribute to the development of a next-generation Deep Digital Twin software for trapped-ion quantum computers. You will work at the intersection of quantum technologies, numerical simulation, scientific computing, and software engineering, developing predictive models that connect microscopic physical processes to system-level performance metrics.

A key component of the position is transforming and extending existing research-grade simulation tools into a robust, scalable, and maintainable software framework. These tools will support hardware design, control optimization, system characterization, performance benchmarking, and the development of fault-tolerant quantum computing architectures.

The Deep Digital Twin is envisioned as a multi-scale simulation framework spanning several layers of abstraction, from ion trapping, control fields, and noise processes, through quantum state preparation and laser cooling to gate dynamics and reasout, ultimately interfacing with circuit-level simulators and quantum error correction workflows.

You will collaborate closely with theorists, experimental physicists, software developers, and engineers to ensure consistency between physical models, numerical simulations, and experimental observations.

Responsibilities:

  • Structure, develop and maintain a Deep Digital Twin framework for trapped-ion quantum computers, setting code and documentation standards

  • Refactor research code into robust, reusable software libraries, improving computational performance through profiling, optimization, and parallelisation

  • Contribute to software validation, benchmarking, and comparison with experimental data

  • Actively contribute to Deep Digital Twin extensions, translating physical models of trapped-ion hardware into scalable simulation tools

  • Connect Deep Digital Twin simulations to higher-level circuit simulators and quantum error correction workflows


Required skills:

  • PhD or equivalent industrial experience in Physics, Scientific Computing, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Solid understanding of quantum mechanics; background in quantum optics, atomic physics, or quantum technologies is advantageous.

  • Excellent Python programming skills and experience with scientific computing libraries (NumPy, SciPy)

  • Experience developing and maintaining scientific software projects

  • Expertise in refactoring research code into modular, maintainable software packages

  • Strong understanding of numerical methods, including linear algebra, differential equations, and optimization

  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, documentation, and code reviews

  • Familiarity with tools such as Numba, Cython, JAX, OpenMP, or similar performance optimization technologies.

  • Ability to work in an international and diverse team at the interface of theory, software, and hardware. 


We Value

  • Experience with trapped-ion quantum computing systems

  • Knowledge of open quantum systems and their simulation

  • Hands-on experience with QuTiP or similar quantum simulation frameworks

  • Experience working in high-performance computing (HPC) environments

  • Scientific software development experience in quantum technologies, AMO physics, or a related field

With around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we are continuing to grow and are looking for people with the right attitude who want to improve the healthcare system alongside us.

We're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What you'll work on

Aftercare provider operations are becoming increasingly complex and data driven. Bringing change is very hard, but we're not afraid. You'll build features that help care facilities, rehabilitation centers, and healthcare chains better allocate resources, unlock actionable insights from patient data, and integrate Recare seamlessly into their internal systems.

Our ambitious roadmap focuses on expanding our marketplace's receiver side with enhanced analytics tools, B2C platforms connecting providers directly with patients, expanded API integrations, and much more.

Secure communication is at our core. Our solution provides end to end encryption for healthcare professionals to safely exchange messages and patient data through both our applications and external API integrations.


In this role, you will:

  • Own a domain inside our core Go codebase, contributing to architecture decisions and code quality within your area

  • Work inside a well structured system with some standalone services around the edges, including an on premise gateway for hospital integrations, rather than a sprawling microservices estate

  • Step in and keep things moving when your lead is away, taking ownership with confidence rather than waiting for instruction

  • Contribute to pull requests, reviews, and technical discussions as a trusted senior voice on your team

We have several products in development that we are confident will significantly impact the German healthcare system. And yes, we're excited by the new opportunities AI unlocks for building powerful features for our customers and our own workflow.

What technologies you'll work with

  • Golang. Our entire backend codebase is in Golang, and we love it. It's easy to learn, it's strongly typed, the internal tooling is fantastic, and it compiles fast.

  • Postgres. We use Postgres for our databases and GORM to interface with it.

  • CI and DevOps. We use both CircleCI and GitHub Actions to run our unit and integration tests, visual regression tests built in house, and automated code analysis through SonarCloud. They're also used to deploy to our various environments.

We also dedicate some of our time to work on non business tasks, which means for instance:

  • Continuously optimising the backend code to offer the best user experience

  • Analysing and improving database slowdowns and issues

  • Internal automation, because we want to make our lives easier

  • Building additional tooling, such as performance profiling tools to identify bottlenecks in backend services and optimise resource usage

Our philosophy is that developers are owners of the code they write until it gets to production. We rely a lot on automated tests to ensure everything stays stable. The rule is that code could be deployed at any time, and manual QA is only involved in new feature validation.


This is what you can expect from us

  • Work with Purpose. Your work has a real impact on patients and healthcare professionals in the medical field.

  • Corporate Culture. We embrace structures that foster high performance and strong team dynamics. Our interactions are characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. We work together towards common goals and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility. Would you like to pick up your child from daycare? Do you enjoy exercising during lunchtime? We support you in achieving that balance. Besides flexible working hours, as a remote-first company we offer the flexibility to work 100% remotely from Germany, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Poland, France and Austria.

  • Edenred card, which you can use in the way that suits you best.

  • Extra Day Off on Your Birthday, so you can celebrate with your loved ones.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Backend Engineer will include

  • Technical Ownership. Own a domain inside our Go codebase, contribute to architectural decisions and code quality within your area, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and suggest or implement improvements.

  • Stepping Up When Needed. Be ready to take charge of priorities and keep things moving if your lead is away, supporting and mentoring other engineers along the way without needing to manage a team.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with product and design to translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate technical progress, risks and trade-offs clearly.

  • Delivery. Ship reliably against the team's roadmap, help break down features into deliverable tasks, and identify and remove blockers as they come up.

  • Building With AI. We are an AI company now, and that shows up in how we expect people to work, not just what we build. Use AI tooling as a genuine part of your day to day, whether that is accelerating how you write and review code, prototyping ideas faster, or finding smarter ways to work. We do not expect you to vibe code everything end to end, plenty of our best engineers still want to write the core of what they ship themselves and use AI to speed things up around the edges. What matters is real curiosity about where this is heading, not scepticism about whether any of this changes how software gets built.



What you will need to succeed as a Senior Backend Engineer:

  • We are looking for experienced developers. You have a CS degree or equivalent knowledge, and you have been coding full time professionally for 4 to 5 plus years

  • We're looking for someone with production experience in Golang, or another C family language with a real, demonstrable ability to operate in Go without hand holding

  • You have some experience supporting or mentoring other engineers, and you are looking for a strong individual contributor role rather than a path into people management

  • You want to become a technical owner of part of our codebase. We need people who are looking for responsibility, just not a team to manage

  • You are a clear, confident communicator, comfortable being put on the spot in a conversation and able to think out loud rather than defaulting to async only communication when something needs a real time answer

  • Since Product and Engineering work in a fully remote setup, writing skills matter more and more, so written questions, requirements, and docs are genuinely valuable

  • You should be comfortable and excited to dive into more advanced topics, for example build pipelines, caching mechanisms, and database optimisation

  • Since we're a small team, we want to automate a lot. You should have experience with CI and testing frameworks

  • You are proactive and proficient across the entire product development flow, asking questions, clarifying specs, raising doubts, and engaging in meetings

  • Healthcare experience is a bonus, not a requirement. FHIR, HL7, or DICOM exposure is great to have, but we have hired strong engineers from fintech, insurtech, and other compliance heavy domains with zero healthcare background who did just fine

  • You are genuinely excited about what AI can do for engineering. We don't expect every line of code to be AI generated, but we do expect curiosity and a real point of view on where this is heading

title: Principal Analytics Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
At Trusted Shops, we’re shaping Europe’s Community of Trust – a space where Businesses and Consumers connect with confidence, transparency, and security. Every day, millions of Users and thousands of Companies across Europe trust us to deliver safe, reliable, and seamless digital experiences.

Data Services is shifting from being strong in raw data to reliably delivering prepared, standardized data products as the foundation for self-service reporting, product-facing APIs (Metrics-as-a-Service), and AI/agent access (e.g. via MCP). Principal Analytics Engineer (f/m/d)

You design together with the teams, not in isolation

  • Standards that make data products real. Modeling conventions, the semantic layer, data-product definitions, testing and data-quality, CI/CD, documentation and metadata, so products are reliably consumable by humans, APIs, and AI agents alike

About the position

As a Project Engineering Manager – Core Spreads Manufacturing, you will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering engineering and capital investment projects across the Core Spreads manufacturing network, with a primary focus on the Pratau and Katowice factories. The role is critical to strengthening manufacturing capability by implementing technically robust, safe, compliant, and cost-effective solutions that improve safety, quality, sustainability, reliability, capacity, and overall operational performance. The role covers the full project lifecycle, from initial business needs definition, feasibility assessment, concept development, budgeting, technical design, and supplier selection through installation, commissioning, qualification, operational handover, and post-implementation review. You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, within the approved budget, in accordance with company engineering standards, and in full compliance with safety, quality, food safety, GMP, and regulatory requirements.

You will:

  • Lead engineering and capital expenditure projects within the Core Spreads factories, ensuring clear scope, objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, timelines, and governance are established from project initiation.
  • Develop and manage project documentation, including business case inputs, user requirement specifications (URS), scope definitions, technical specifications, cost estimates, project schedules, risk registers, procurement packages, commissioning plans, and handover documentation.
  • Coordinate engineering design, equipment selection, vendor technical clarification, procurement support, installation planning, construction supervision, commissioning, qualification, and start-up activities.
  • Monitor project progress, costs, risks, and milestones, escalating issues where required and implementing corrective actions to ensure delivery against agreed targets.
  • Ensure effective project close-out, including completion of technical documentation, training, asset registration, maintenance requirements, lessons learned, and operational handover to site teams.
  • Perform engineering assessments, feasibility studies, option evaluations, and technical risk reviews to support investment decisions and project prioritisation.
  • Analyse process, packaging, utilities, and equipment performance data to identify opportunities to improve reliability, increase efficiency, reduce waste, improve yield, reduce energy consumption, and optimise costs.
  • Lead or support structured troubleshooting activities for recurring technical issues, applying root cause analysis and practical engineering problem-solving methodologies.
  • Drive value creation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, and T&I teams.
  • Support the standardisation of technical solutions, equipment specifications, and engineering ways of working across the Core Spreads manufacturing network.
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Safety, Procurement, Finance, and T&I stakeholders to ensure project objectives are aligned with business priorities and site operational needs.
  • Coordinate external suppliers, contractors, OEMs, and engineering service providers, ensuring clear technical communication, effective scope management, safety compliance, and high delivery performance.
  • Prepare clear project updates, decision papers, presentations, budget summaries, risk assessments, and steering committee materials for site and regional leadership teams.
  • Facilitate effective communication between sites, functions, and project teams to enable timely decision-making, resource availability, and smooth project execution during factory operations.
  • Ensure all project activities comply with company engineering standards, site safety rules, contractor management requirements, food safety standards, quality systems, GMP requirements, and all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead or support Management of Change (MoC) processes, ensuring that technical, operational, safety, quality, environmental, and financial impacts are appropriately assessed, documented, approved, and implemented.
  • Promote a strong safety and compliance culture by ensuring that appropriate risk assessments, method statements, permit-to-work procedures, contractor supervision, and safe start-up practices are in place.
  • Maintain accurate project records and support audit readiness through disciplined documentation, full traceability of decisions, and controlled handover of technical information.

So what does it take to be successful in this role?  

You have a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related field, along with at least five years of experience in project engineering, process engineering, maintenance engineering, or capital project delivery within the food industry or a similarly regulated manufacturing environment. You bring solid knowledge of food processing, packaging technologies, hygienic design principles, operational excellence, and change management practices. You have a strong understanding of engineering project delivery processes, industrial equipment, utilities, process systems, packaging lines, commissioning, and operational handover. You have demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, suppliers, contractors, risks, and cross-functional stakeholders in a manufacturing environment, and are able to balance strategic project objectives with practical factory execution, ensuring technical solutions are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with long-term site and category manufacturing strategies. You are fluent in both English and German, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn. You are an effective communicator and collaborative team player, open to traveling for project execution, supplier visits, factory acceptance tests (FATs), and on-site activities. Additionally, you are proficient in MS Office and engineering software such as AutoCAD and SolidWorks.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR:

We are a product-driven organization building technology that unlocks the value in video and image data without compromising the people it captures. As part of Milestone Systems, we bring together anonymization and responsibly sourced, fully traceable video data with specialized AI models across our product portfolio. We are seeking an ambitious Product Manager driven by customer satisfaction, product success, and opportunities for growth. You will work with customers, commercial and development teams, and senior management to align on a product vision, define a roadmap, and bring stakeholders together to continuously develop our product strategy. If you understand the software-as-a-service business model and AI and computer-vision technologies, this role is for you. You must have a passion for great customer experiences paired with strong product skills. This is what will make you successful in this role.

YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • You will define a product vision together with the Director of Product and the product team, set strategic priorities, and translate this vision into a product roadmap supported by meaningful KPIs.
  • You will approach customers and stakeholders with genuine curiosity and translate these insights into ideas and actions that delight them.
  • You will act as the strategic link between product vision and technical execution and be responsible for product ownership across the development teams.
  • You will identify opportunities for new products and product improvements by researching markets and interacting with customers, potential customers, and partners.
  • You will collaborate with key internal stakeholders such as tech development and support teams, sales, and senior management to shape and drive the product agenda.

IN ORDER FOR YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU BRING:

  • You have 4+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager in a technical environment or a comparable position, ideally in B2B SaaS, artificial intelligence, or both.
  • You have strong skills in defining product, product vision, and product family strategy.
  • You are an effective product advocate who communicates clearly with stakeholders at every level and ensures that feedback from customers and internal teams directly influences product development.
  • You have a good understanding of software-as-a-service business models.
  • You are a self-starting leader, detail-oriented, process-oriented, and organized.
  • You are fluent in written and spoken English.

ALSO DESIRABLE:

  • Your experience with products in computer vision, AI, or video management domains is a plus.

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Friendly cooperation at eye level - We live and breathe flat hierarchies with a positive feedback culture.
  • Innovation where it matters - A challenging position in a company that is changing the world of video data: With you we will make history.
  • Creative and entrepreneurial playground - Get a chance to be your own master, define your own tasks, actively contribute and implement your ideas. Grow yourself and grow the success of the company with direct influence from day one.
  • Team spirit celebrates diversity - Numerous events to get to know the teams and meet our great visionaries.
  • Flexible working hours - Trust-based and goal-oriented working culture.
  • Benefits to smooth your ride in life - Public transport ticket with a 50% subsidy and a huge discount on Urban Sports Club memberships.
  • Boost your learning – we’ll fund it - We offer a generous learning budget so you can improve your skills.

title: Senior Recruiter (f/m/d) Remote Germany
description:
The role in brief

You will join selectry as a Senior Recruiter and run end-to-end searches through our Hiring Engine for our clients. You own the process from structured intake to signed offer, use data to improve it, and build the sourcing infrastructure that makes the next search faster than the one before.

Why this role exists

selectry is a Berlin-based hr-tech company. We build and operate the Hiring Engine for plannable recruiting. Our three product lines cover different levels of recruiting ownership for our clients. What they share is a common requirement: searches need to be run well, documented clearly, and improved continuously.

We are a small, senior team. Decisions move quickly. The work is concrete. We run our own searches and source proactively rather than relying on inbound volume. We source, assess, and advise, and we document every step.

This role exists because the Hiring Engine needs an experienced recruiter who can carry searches independently, consult clients and hiring managers with evidence and clarity, and help build the sourcing and process infrastructure that makes selectry's output reliable and repeatable.

What you will work on

  • Own the full recruiting lifecycle across client searches, from intake and role clarification through active sourcing, structured assessment, and offer management to signed contract

  • Design and run multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, XING, and direct outreach, including complex Boolean search and talent mapping for specialist and leadership profiles

  • Build and maintain talent pools of passive candidates across the segments selectry searches most frequently, structured, auditable, and ready for the next search

  • Conduct structured, competency-based interviews and advise hiring managers on evaluation criteria, profile fit, and decision quality

  • Track, analyse, and report on recruiting KPIs, including time-to-hire, time-to-fill, funnel conversion, and source-of-hire, and use the data to improve the process at every stage

  • Create and maintain search briefs, outreach templates, and interview guides within selectry's documentation infrastructure

  • Lead employer branding projects for selectry itself, for example career page content, candidate experience improvements, and outreach standards



Must-haves

  • Strong experience in recruiting, with end-to-end ownership of complex, specialist, or leadership hiring processes from sourcing through to offer

  • Hands-on active sourcing experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and multi-channel direct outreach, including the ability to design Boolean search strategies and talent maps independently

  • Experience building and maintaining structured talent pools for passive candidate segments using a CRM or ATS

  • Experience conducting competency-based candidate interviews and advising hiring managers on evaluation frameworks and profile decisions

  • KPI literacy: you have tracked recruiting data and used it to change a process, with a concrete example you can explain

  • German at C2 level and English at minimum C1, both required from day one, as searches run in both languages

  • Reliable self-management in a remote setup, careful documentation, and clear written communication

Nice-to-haves

  • Background in sales recruiting, executive search, or specialist/leadership hiring in a B2B or technology environment

  • Delivered employer branding work with concrete outputs, for example employer value proposition (EVP) development, career page content, candidate experience design, or career fair coordination

  • Familiarity with mid-market ATS or CRM-based recruiting platforms, for example Personio, Greenhouse, or Recruitee

  • Familiarity with the DACH talent market and its sourcing dynamics, particularly for niche or hard-to-fill profiles

How we work

selectry is fully remote within Germany, with our registered office in Berlin. The team is deliberately small so decisions are made quickly and work stays concrete. We use documented playbooks, clean process logic, and a tooling setup.

Technology supports the work. Humans verify and decide. That applies to how we run our product and to how we work internally.

There are no vanity metrics here. A good search is one where the right person was found, the process was fair, and the documentation lets us learn from it.

Working conditions

Location: 100% remote (DE), registered office in Berlin

Work model: Full-time, flexible hours with agreed collaboration windows

Contract: Permanent employment

Languages: German C2 (mandatory), English min. C1 (mandatory)

Salary: Discussed transparently in the first conversation

Start: As soon as possible

Holiday: 30 days plus public holidays in your federal state

Qualifikation

DAS SOLLTEST DU MITBRINGEN

Für den Einsatz als Ausbilder:in in unserer IHK-Umschulung musst du sowohl arbeitspädagogisch als auch fachlich für deine Fachrichtung geeignet sein.   • Reines Informatik- bzw. IT-Studium plus AEVO, oder
  • Abschluss als Fachinformatiker:in in der gesuchten Fachrichtung plus AEVO, oder
  • Abschluss als Fachinformatiker:in in der jeweils anderen Fachrichtung, mindestens 1 Jahr einschlägige Vollzeit-Berufspraxis in der gesuchten Fachrichtung, plus AEVO, oder
  • Als Quereinsteiger:in mindestens 4,5 Jahre nachgewiesene, einschlägige Vollzeit-Berufspraxis in der gesuchten Fachrichtung (Anwendungsentwicklung bzw. Systemintegration), plus AEVO.

Als Berufspraxis zählt operative Tätigkeit in einem IT-Unternehmen oder einer IT-Abteilung, z. Darüber hinaus überzeugst du uns durch:

Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und erklärst komplexe Themen logisch und nachvollziehbar. Du bringst eine Affinität zur (Online-)Lehre / E-Learning und web-basierten Lernprogrammen mit.
  • Einsätze vor Ort: Du bist im Raum Hamburg oder Bochum verfügbar; der genaue Präsenzanteil richtet sich nach den Vorgaben der jeweils zuständigen IHK (z. B. mindestens 51 % Präsenz in Hamburg).

Benefits

  • Ein Business mit Purpose: Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die wirtschaftlich, gesellschaftlich und sozial höchst relevant sind (Digitalisierung, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit des Wirtschaftsstandorts Deutschland, Arbeitsmarktpolitik, Gleichberechtigung, Technologie etc.)

Wenn du glaubst, dass diese Rolle gut zu dir passt, bewirb dich gerne bei uns. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a passionate and driven Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our People team in Spain! This is a fully remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere in the country. Please note that candidates must currently reside in Spain.

Join us at an exciting stage of growth at Wellhub, where you'll play a key role in shaping our European expansion. As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will partner closely with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to attract, engage, and hire top talent across the region.

In this role, you'll translate business needs into effective hiring strategies, helping to build high-performing teams that drive success in both established and new markets. You'll take ownership of end-to-end recruitment processes, ensuring an outstanding candidate experience while maintaining speed and quality.

Beyond day-to-day hiring, you'll contribute to improving recruiting practices through data-driven insights, helping us scale efficiently as we continue to grow. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a mix of hands-on recruiting and strategic impact, and who is excited to help shape the future of our teams across Europe.

  • Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for non-technical roles up to G7 level, ensuring high-quality hires and alignment with business needs.
  • Partner closely with Hiring Managers and People Business Partners to define hiring strategies, evaluation criteria, and ensure a seamless calibration through kickoff meetings.
  • Develop and implement innovative sourcing strategies to build diverse talent pipelines and improve overall hiring effectiveness.
  • Drive a positive candidate experience by maintaining transparent communication, providing timely feedback, and acting as a professional brand ambassador for Wellhub.
  • Analyze recruitment metrics and data to identify bottlenecks, optimize processes, and formally propose improvements to increase the TA function's efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with global labor laws, internal SLAs, and data accuracy (cost centers, candidate stages, and budget alignment) within our ATS (Greenhouse).
  • Promote diversity, equity, and belonging by proactively sourcing from underrepresented groups and mitigating biases throughout the selection process.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (People Ops, OD&B) to ensure smooth onboarding and contribute to employer branding initiatives.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in full-cycle recruitment, with a focus on high-demand environments.
  • Strong analytical skills to track, interpret, and report recruitment metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to match financial budgets with candidate expectations regarding salary and benefits.
  • Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), preferably Greenhouse, to manage candidate pipelines.
  • Solid knowledge of sourcing strategies and tools to attract diverse talent.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven track record of ensuring a high-quality candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
  • Fluency in English and German is required. Additional proficiency in either French or Spanish is preferred.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in full-cycle recruitment and fluency in English and German are mandatory requirements.

 

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

As a Junior Security Operations Engineering Consultant (m/w/d) located in Germany you will assist in various Security Operations Center (SOC) projects. You will gain exposure to SOC engineering concepts such as log onboarding, detection engineering, and SIEM technologies. Under the guidance of senior team members, you will support the design and implementation of security solutions for customers across different sectors.

You have strong communication and interpersonal skills, which enable you not only to understand requirements, but also to put these requirements into a development plan, explain it to customers and guarantee proper execution. You have an open and approachable mind, in line with NVISO's values.

Typical tasks include but are not limited to:

  • Planning and managing the onboarding of new log sources, troubleshooting issues with log sources or systems with clients and vendors;
  • Creating technical and process playbooks;
  • Defining and setting up correlation rules, based on threat intelligence and specific customer requirements;
  • Contributing to incident response procedures;
  • Ensuring you remain up to speed with latest trends and technologies in the SOC field.

You are passionate about cyber security, engineering and automation. Building solutions and working with customers energizes you and you look forward to growing in all the aforementioned domains.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship;
  • 1-2 years of practical experience (such as a SOC Analyst) in the field of cybersecurity or IT is mandatory;
  • Experience with Azure Sentinel, Microsoft Security stack, or SIEM technologies such as Elastic, Splunk, or LogPoint;
  • Experience with scripting in Python and/or other relevant scripting or automation language is a big plus;
  • Ideally, familiarity with SIEM query languages or an interest in learning Sigma and YARA rules;
  • Experience or coursework related to cybersecurity is beneficial.

Soft skills

  • Ability to work independently, and keep track of your priorities;
  • Strong interpersonal and verbal/written communication skills that enable the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment across the entire company;
  • Excellent English and German communication skills, both verbal and written;
  • A positive, team-oriented, and mission-driven attitude;
  • Ability to prepare and present your work to colleagues.

Benefits

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);
  • Generous training budget of 10.000 EUR + 10 man days for attending lectures rolling over 2 years;
  • An annual gross base salary between 57.000 EUR and 62.000 EUR, depending on your experience;
  • Support for technical growth with Cloud trainings + certifications (AWS, GCP, Azure);
  • Regular team-building and fun events;
  • Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career!
  • Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad weeks within the EU);
  • Business Bike Leasing;
  • BahnCard 50 1st class + public transfer ticket;
  • 30 holidays;
  • Cool offices in the center of Frankfurt, Munich and Vienna (with BBQ, kicker table, table tennis, playstations, etc.).

You have an open and approachable mind, in line with NVISO's values.

description:

Classification: Full-time; 40 hours per week

Pay Range: €51,000-90,000

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! Our K-8 platforms include Miacademy, Always Icecream, and Clever Dragons, and our 9-12 options include MiaPrep and MiaPrep Online High School. Our student base is rapidly growing, and we’re hiring for multiple positions across several departments! Our expansion stems from our commitment to providing exceptional educational content and our pursuit of new opportunities. 🚀

▶️ You can hear our CEO, Johannes Ziegler, discuss our company’s values and future!

How you’ll make an impact (position summary):

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

The Role

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our current QA team. You'll take ownership of how we test, validate, and sign off on quality across our platform. We're actively investing in our QA practice: expanding automated test coverage, improving our release testing process, and moving toward a model where quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle.

You'll report to a technical Engineering Manager and work alongside engineers who value clear test documentation, reliable automation, and confident code releases.

As a mature company, we have legacy systems and established manual testing workflows, but we are transitioning to modern automated testing practices using Playwright and TypeScript. The split between manual and automated work varies, but you should be comfortable working across both, bringing automation where it adds the most value while pragmatically maintaining manual coverage where it's still the right tool.

A core goal of our QA evolution is to make testing faster, more reliable, and less dependent on last-minute changes before each release: replacing fragile manual regression cycles with stable automated suites, reducing flakiness, and building coverage that the whole team can rely on. Every testing investment is measured by whether it improves quality and reduces the team's burden at release time.

What You'll Do

  • Write and maintain automated regression tests; review automation MRs from peers

  • Execute manual testing across web UIs (functional, regression, cross-platform, responsive layouts on mobile/tablet)

  • Create and maintain test cases, checklists, and test documentation in TestRail

  • File clear, actionable bug reports with reproduction steps; collaborate with developers to triage and resolve

  • Own the release testing process to ensure only high-quality changes ship

  • Partner with PMs and designers on requirements review, edge cases, and acceptance criteria

  • Contribute to QA process improvements as we scale (currently a 2-person team growing to 4)

How We Work

We believe you should know what your days look like before you accept an offer.

We don't have much bureaucracy. Small team, direct communication, short decision loops. If you've worked at places where opening a Jira ticket to request a Jira ticket was normal, this isn't that. Here's the reality:

Meetings (yes, we keep them minimal):

  • Daily standup with your product team. Show up, share updates and unblock each other..

  • Sprint planning and retrospectives with your product team, once per sprint.

  • 1:1 with your Engineering Manager - Regular cadence, your agenda.

  • Monthly Engineering all-hands.

  • That's it. The rest of your time is yours to work.

Deployments:

  • Bi-monthly release cadence with a schedule published in advance. As a QA Engineer, you own the release testing window. Coordinating with developers, running regression suites, and signing off on quality before the release.

  • Infrequent ad-hoc hotfixes

Communication:

  • Async-friendly. Documentation-first.

  • Slack/ Jira/ GitLab MRs/ Notion

  • Google Workspace for email and documents.

  • Zoom for video calls.

Timezone:

  • We need significant overlap with typical CET (Central European Time) working hours to coordinate and collaborate synchronously. Additionally we have stakeholders and developers in US timezones that we occasionally need to meet.


What We're Looking For

Requirements (Requisite Skills): 

  • 2+ years of QA engineering experience, including web UI testing

  • 1+ years of experience with Playwright or a similar test automation framework (e.g. Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer)

  • Strong test design skills: comfortable writing and maintaining test cases, checklists, and test documentation

  • Familiarity with QA's role in the SDLC and how to collaborate with developers and PMs

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

  • Upper-intermediate English (B2+) for written and spoken communication

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accessibility and/or security testing

How you’ll work with other teams:

Career Growth

We have a defined career ladder. Whether your path leads toward Senior/Staff QA Engineer or Engineering Management, there's room to grow - and we'll work with you to get there.

Onboarding

Every team member gets full support throughout onboarding, and no one expects you to figure out the ins and outs on your own. We'll pair with you, answer every question, and make sure you have the context you need. New hires typically feel very supported at Miaplaza.

What success looks like here: In the first couple of months, you're asking a lot of clarifying questions, reading documentation, exploring the product independently, and writing and running tests with confidence. By months 3-4, you're taking ownership of a specific area, building out test coverage, identifying gaps, and driving quality improvements. By month 5-6, you're contributing meaningfully to the testing strategy for migration and modernisation work and operating independently. The common thread: curiosity, initiative, and the habit of investigating before you ask, but always asking when you need to.

Interview Process

Our process is staged and designed to respect your time. Expect a mix of introductory conversation, technical discussion, and practical evaluation. We want to understand how you think about real problems and testing practices. As part of the process, we will ask for professional references and conduct a background check. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, let us know, we're happy to help.

Compensation

Competitive compensation, open to negotiation based on your experience and expertise. We'll discuss specifics early in the process so neither side wastes time. Since we’re remote-first, every arrangement is different; we tailor time off, benefits, and perks as part of your individual contract to ensure the overall package works for both sides.

Ready to apply?

Join our team at Miaplaza! Start by submitting your application and resume. Our hiring process involves a screening call, followed by a behavioral interview, and two technical interviews.

title: AI Engineer (m/w/d) für Chat-to-CAD / LLM, Agents und multimodale Eingaben
description:
Du liebst es, mit Sprachmodellen zu arbeiten und komplexe Probleme zu lösen?

Willkommen bei CADAICO, der Heimat für neugierige Entwickler:innen, KI-Nerds, Geeks und Engineering Talente.

# Es werden nur Bewerbungen mit Anschreiben berücksichtigt. #

Ein großer Teil unserer Arbeit ist, aus sehr unterschiedlichen Eingaben – Text, Zeichnungen, technischen Unterlagen – möglichst vollständig alle Informationen herauszuholen und sauber zusammenzuführen.
Schreib uns in zwei, drei Sätzen, wo du sowas schon gebaut hast: Was waren die Herausforderungen dabei, und wie hast du sie gelöst?

Unser Dev-Team ist klein, aber sehr fein – zwei, drei Leute. Deine Arbeit ist unmittelbar sichtbar und zählt vom ersten Tag an. Wer echte Verantwortung sucht, ist hier richtig.

Unser Startup

CADAICO, die Chat-to-Design Company, ist ein Startup aus Stuttgart, das von Pedram, einem ehemaligen Mid-Level Manager aus dem Maschinenbau, und Daniel, einem KI-Forscher vom KIT gegründet wurde.

Unser Team baut Software, die KI-Methoden mit herkömmlichen Algorithmen kombiniert – damit Ingenieur:innen im Maschinenbau ihre Konstruktionen automatisiert erstellen können, statt manuell mit CAD-Tools.

Mit vielversprechenden Projekten in der Pipeline haben wir eine gute Grundlage für die nächste Wachstumsphase und suchen dafür Menschen, die selbstständig denken, Verantwortung übernehmen und echte KI-Produkte bauen wollen, die den Maschinenbau prägen.

Aufgaben

Was du bei uns machst

  • Baue das KI-Herz unseres Chat-to-Design Produkts schrittweise weiter:
    von der LLM-Anbindung bis zum produktiven Agenten
  • Sorge dafür, dass unsere Software kundenspezifisch lernt, ohne dass ein Modell trainiert wird – über versionierte System-Prompts, Wissensbasen, Regelwerke, Feedback- und Memory-Systeme. Kundenspezifik über Architektur anstatt über Gewichtung
  • Bring unserem Produkt bei, aus wenigen, sehr unterschiedlichen Eingaben – auch nicht-textuellen – verlässlich alle Informationen herauszuholen und in strukturierten Output zu überführen – samt der nötigen Retrieval- und Wissensbausteine über Konstruktions- und Bauteildaten
  • Erstelle Agentic Workflows: Tool Use, Function Calling, mehrstufiges Reasoning und robuste Fehlerbehandlung
  • Setze komplexe KI-Ideen in zuverlässige, produktive Softwarefeatures um – gemeinsam mit unseren Engineers.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python und sauberes, wartbares Engineering – Typing, Tests, verständliche APIs
  • Erfahrung damit, aus unstrukturierten oder mehrdeutigen Eingaben strukturierte, verlässliche Ergebnisse zu machen – idealerweise auch aus nicht-textuellen Quellen (Bilder, Dokumente, technische Unterlagen)
  • Erfahrung mit Retrieval (Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Re-Ranking) – und ein Gespür dafür, warum das mit echten Daten schwieriger ist als im Tutorial
  • Erfahrung mit Agentic Workflows: Tool Use bzw. Function Calling, mehrstufiges Reasoning – und ein Gefühl dafür, was passiert, wenn das Modell danebengreift
  • Du hast schon mehr gebaut als einen Chatbot: ein System, in dem ein Sprachmodell etwas tut – Tools aufruft, über eigene Daten arbeitet oder mehrere Schritte verkettet. Ob im Job, im Studium oder im eigenen Projekt, ist uns egal
  • Lust, tief in ein Thema einzusteigen, eigene Entscheidungen zu treffen und dir Unbekanntes schnell anzueignen
  • Sehr gutes Englisch und gute Deutschkenntnisse für eine sichere interne und externe Kommunikation
  • Eine bestehende Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland. Als kleines Team können wir leider keine Visa-Unterstützung leisten.

--

Schön, wenn du davon etwas kennst - Den Rest lernst du bei uns.

  • Agent-Frameworks wie LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI oder MCP
  • Systematische Evaluation von LLM-Outputs (Golden Sets, LLM-as-Judge, Langfuse, Ragas)
  • Erfahrung mit dem Auslesen von Informationen aus Bildern oder Dokumenten
  • CAD-Software oder Erfahrung im Maschinenbau-Umfeld

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Standort in Stuttgart (On-Site) mit sehr flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und hybridem Arbeiten
  • Agiles Arbeiten mit flachen Hierarchien: Keine endlosen Freigabeschleifen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, triffst Entscheidungen und setzt schnell um
  • Starke Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Deine Möglichkeiten wachsen mit unserem Startup
  • Echte Verantwortung und sichtbarer Impact: Was du tust, zählt. Sehr sogar.
  • Raum zum Experimentieren: Ideen entwickeln, schnell testen, lernen und umsetzen
  • Gehalt: 60.000 – 85.000 € + VSOP-Option je nach Erfahrung und Verantwortung.

Warum CADAICO?

Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen und mit Freude zur Arbeit gehen möchtest, bist du hier richtig ;)

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Hintergründe, Altersgruppen und Identitäten.

Schick deinen CV zusammen mit deiner Antwort auf die Frage von oben und gern einem Link zu etwas, das du gebaut hast (Repo, Demo, Blogpost)

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Pedram

title: Interim Business Continuity Manager (m/w/d) - Elternzeitvertretung
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst von Oktober 2026 bis September 2027 die Weiterentwicklung unseres BCM (Business Continuity Management):

  • Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung: Erstellung von BCM-Dokumentationen (Leitlinien, Handbücher, Prozessen, etc.) und Entwicklung von Konzepten und Plänen zur Verbesserung und Etablierung eines BCM.
  • Kommunikation: Informationsveranstaltungen und Schulungen für Fachbereiche.
  • BIA und Risikoanalyse: Begleitung der Durchführung von Business Impact Analysen, um kritische Prozesse und deren maximale Ausfallzeiten zu bestimmen.
  • Notfallplanung: Erstellung von Geschäftsfortführungs-, Wiederherstellungs- und Wiederanlaufplänen in enger und anleitender Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen (vor allem IT).
  • Szenariobildung: Konzeption von BCM-Szenarien und entsprechende Anwendung auf Geschäftsfortführungspläne.
  • Krisenmanagement: Etablierung eines Krisenstab-Prozesses und Kommunikationsplanung als IKT-Kommunikationsmanager:in.
  • Testen & Üben: Konzeption eines mehrjährigen BCM-Testplans, als auch Initiator:in und Leiter:in der BCM-Tests. Zusätzlich bzw. optional würdest Du den Aufbau und später die Leitung des IKS (Internes Kontrollsystem) übernehmen. Hierzu gehört u.a. die Unterstützung der Fachbereiche bei der Prozessdokumentation und dem Prozess-Design, die Identifikation von Schlüsselprozessen, Prozessrisiken und Implementierung risikoorientierter Kontrollen, die Erstellung und Pflege der Risk-Control-Matrix (RCM) sowie die Durchführung von Self-Assessments und Wirksamkeitsprüfungen der Kontrollen. Du würdest für diese Themen jeweils die Schnittstelle zur Internen Revision und zu den Jahresabschlussprüfer:innen bilden.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mindestens 3–5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich BCM oder Risk Management und IKS, idealerweise im Finanzsektor, einem regulierten Tech-Umfeld oder in der Beratung mit.
  • Du hast gute Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Anforderungen im Bereich BCM (z.B. MaRisk, DORA, BSI 200-4).
  • Hands-On Mentalität: Du bist jemand, der bereit ist, selbst „die Ärmel hochzukrempeln" und mit einem Ziel vor Augen eigenständig Konzepte, Pläne und Aufgaben von Beginn bis Ende realisierst.
  • Du hast Interesse und Motivation Themen von Beginn bis zur Realisierung zu denken und umzusetzen und scheust dich nicht vor komplexeren Zusammenhängen und langfristigen Aufgaben.
  • Du denkst dich gerne in neue oder sich ändernde regulatorische Anforderungen ein und bist bereit dich thematisch weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch.

Warum wir?

  • Ein internationales / grenzüberschreitendes Team, das eng zusammenarbeitet.
  • Kleines Team - Einfluss auf die Teamkultur und das Produkt.
  • Die Freiheit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Coaching und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Die Möglichkeit, remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder von unserem zentralen Büro in Frankfurt zu arbeiten.
  • Wir bieten diese Stelle in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (80%) an.

title: Senior Immobilien Investment Vertriebsfachberater (d/w/m)
description:
Investfriend - ein neues Portfoliounternehmen von Hypofriend - ist Vorreiter bei der Förderung von Investitionen in energieeffiziente Mietimmobilien (insbesondere in Berlin und Umgebung).

Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, erstklassige Immobilienprojekte auszuwählen, die aufgrund neuer Abschreibungsvorschriften und spezieller KfW-Förderprogramme von erweiterten Steuervorteilen profitieren. Investfriend ermöglicht transparente Investitionen in solche Objekte mit zu erwartenden jährlichen Renditen von 10-30%, bei gleichzeitiger Minimierung des Verwaltungsaufwandes. Dies ergänzt unsere Beratung zu Spar- und Investitionsstrategien sowie die steuer- und renditeoptimierten, ETF-basierten Sparpläne, die wir über unser anderes Portfoliounternehmen Pensionfriend anbieten.

Aufgaben

  • Expertise in der Investmentberatung: Biete maßgeschneiderte Investmentberatung für individuelle Kundinnen und Kunden, hauptsächlich im Bereich Immobilieninvestitionen, aber auch bei ETF-Plänen.
  • Projektanalyse: Analysiere und helfe bei der Auswahl attraktiver energieeffizienter Immobilienprojekte mit hohen Renditechancen.
  • Steuerliche Beratung: Unterstütze besonders einkommensstarke Kundinnen und Kunden dabei, die Vorteile neuer Abschreibungsgesetze und KfW-Förderungen zu verstehen und zu maximieren.

title: Senior Product Manager - House Owner & Service Request Acquisition (all genders)
description:
Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and grow the top of our marketplace funnel.

Aroundhome is a two-sided marketplace platform where the possibility of shared success begins with the match: the moment a homeowner is connected with the right partner. The House Owner & Service Request Acquisition domain owns everything upstream of that match. It starts when a homeowner discovers Aroundhome through search or content, continues as they describe their home project, and ends when a qualified service request is handed to matching. The quality of that request shapes the experience on both sides of the marketplace, so acquisition volume, conversion, and data quality are all part of your responsibility.

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping the success of Germany's leading housing project platform. We work in a domain-based model, where each product team owns a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration within cross-functional teams and ensures that the expertise for continuous product discovery, hypothesis development, and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

As a Senior Product Manager, you drive and execute the strategy, set a clear direction, and make sure your domain delivers meaningful value to both customer groups, homeowners and partners, as well as to the business.

  • You continuously shape domain strategy and vision, setting clear measurable goals and a roadmap for homeowner acquisition: steering the full acquisition mix across paid and unpaid channels with a clear focus on growing the organic share, improving conversion along the homeowner journey, and raising the quality of the service requests handed to matching. You actively rally those around you toward this vision.
  • You grow sustainable, unpaid acquisition through SEO, AI search optimization and scalable acquisition systems that compound over time, while keeping paid channels an effective and efficient part of the mix. You design and read high-traffic conversion experiments to lift conversion and data quality.
  • You are responsible for building a robust architecture and foundation that supports our acquisition experience. You ensure our setup is scalable and ready for automated qualification, enabling seamless processes that benefit the entire marketplace.
  • You identify where AI genuinely improves the homeowner experience and the platform's qualification processes, and you bring those opportunities into production together with Engineering, from first prompt experiments to shipped, measurable features.
  • You drive domain growth through continuous end-to-end product discovery, using qualitative insights (interviews, usability tests, feedback, NPS) and quantitative data to identify opportunities and make evidence-based, outcome-driven decisions with measurable impact.
  • You communicate with clarity and purpose, translate complex system and data topics into compelling narratives, and foster strong collaboration across Product, Tech, Product Analytics, UX, SEO and Content, Sales, and cross-domain stakeholders. You help carry the shift from a sales-driven organization toward a product platform.
  • You ensure a strong balance between long-term strategic goals and short-term trade-offs, driving continuous lean delivery through effective backlog management and close collaboration with Engineering and Design.

Skills

  • You have hands-on experience building organic acquisition and understand SEO fundamentals (topical authority, local SEO, structured data, page performance) as well as how AI-driven search and assistants are changing discovery (AEO), ideally within a marketplace or high-volume consumer platform.
  • You are experienced in optimizing complex user funnels and conversion flows, using experimentation (A/B testing) and data to improve conversion, quality, and user trust while laying the foundation for long-term platform engagement.
  • You apply strong analytical thinking and product analytics skills to define success measures, interpret data, uncover insights, and guide evidence-based decisions that improve homeowner and business outcomes.
  • You bring a strong technical affinity to help shape our underlying acquisition and conversion architecture. You understand the concepts of data models or taxonomies and have enough grasp of APIs and data flows to reason about feasibility and sequencing with engineers.
  • You work with LLMs as a natural part of your daily practice and can show concretely how they strengthen your discovery, analysis, and delivery. Ideally, you have taken AI beyond personal productivity and understand how scalable AI solutions reach production-grade features, for example through prompt chains, LLM-supported data extraction, or automated qualification flows.
  • You bring order into chaos by bringing together diverse perspectives, challenges, and priorities to establish shared understanding and strong alignment across teams, and you are comfortable chairing decisions no single team owns.
  • You think entrepreneurially and achieve your goals with a high degree of responsibility and ownership.
  • You follow the latest trends in product management and technology, are an absolute team player, and your excellent communication skills in English (and German as a nice-to-have), along with a good sense of humor, characterize you.

What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.
